meta.what: HTTP transcript of a pilot run through the real route table and Pilot class (in memory, fixed clock, stand-in tracker)
meta.warning: All keys, codes, ids and tokens here are PUBLIC TEST FIXTURES from an in-memory run. None is valid on any server. Never use the test keys for anything real.
meta.placeholders: Bearer tokens, invite codes and the admin token are replaced by <name> placeholders; replace them with your own when replaying.
meta.replay: check_python.py replays every step with a client_call through a Python client (the Hermes plugin or the valun package): the client is given the recorded client_reads, its request body must equal the recorded one (signatures aside), and its signatures must verify over the exact bytes in server_verified.
meta.signer_stand_in: Steps marked as signer or tracker failures switch the stand-in to an outage (BasisError "signer timed out", code signer_unavailable, as lib/basis.mjs throws for a timeout, a failed start or no output), to reporting an error for the input (BasisError "signer: ...", code signer_error), or to an unreachable tracker (code tracker_unavailable). The real valun_signer and tracker are not run. One step sets a note on the stand-in tracker directly (stand_in_tracker), as a note submitted around Valun would be.
